# Create today's habit tracking note based on yesterday's content, with good posture set to yes.
today_str = today.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
yesterday_content = yesterday_note['content']
# Replace the posture line

    content=new_content,
    access_token=access_token,
    tags=['habit-tracker'],
    pinned=True
)
print(result)
